msg: I have to admit that I didn't use a consistent strategy at all. If you are very smart, it may be that there is a correlation between the colour of the gnome and/or size of the hat and/or which side they are on. Or it could be that in specific pairs e.g. tall hat vs flat hat, that one always trumps the other. But I did not systematically figure this out! I had a feeling the gnome on the right usually gave more mushrooms, so I think the majority of the time I spent on that side. When the mushrooms decreased, I would have a go at left and then switch around between them until right gave lots of mushrooms again. Good luck!
